summary: Iteration 2 — tested NEW features only (Edit Txn PATCH, Recurring CRUD + Run + Toggle, Budgets CRUD + progress calc, sidebar nav, dashboard auto-run). Backend: 17/17 pytest passed. Frontend: all 11 requested flows verified end-to-end via Playwright.

issues: CRA/webpack error overlay pops up for 'ResizeObserver loop completed with undelivered notifications' after rapid radix Select interactions. This is a well-known benign browser warning (not a real error). It does NOT affect production builds, but in dev it blocks click interactions. Optional fix: add a global window.addEventListener('error', e => { if (e.message.includes('ResizeObserver loop')) { e.stopImmediatePropagation(); } }) in index.js, OR disable react-error-overlay in dev.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py update_recurring uses raw body: dict but Pydantic model would be safer (currently allowlist filters keys, so no injection risk — acceptable).
_next_due for monthly clamps day to min(day_of_month or from_dt.day, 28) — intentional to avoid month-end issues (good).
Recurring auto-gen loop capped at 24 iterations per rule — good safety.
Budgets upsert uses unique index (user_id, category) — matches server.py startup index creation.
Percent calc guards against amount==0 division (returns 0) — good.
Dashboard.load() calls POST /api/recurring/run inside try/catch — silent, non-blocking. Correct.
AddTransactionDialog useEffect on [type] resets category only in create mode (via isEdit flag) — correctly preserves category during edit.
